name: taskforge
description: Helpdesk interne de gestion de tickets d'incidents

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint:check
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit -- --run
